questions.subject: ITALIAN
questions.stem: While checking the answers, a pupil records one word for the lesson. Choose the conditional: "lui/lei viaggiare".

options.misconception: this is the tu form of the verb, not lui/lei
this is the loro form of the verb, not lui/lei
this is the noi form of the verb, not lui/lei

questions.explanation: The conditional form of "viaggiare" for "lui/lei" is "viaggiarebbe". The conditional uses the future stem with a different set of endings. It expresses politeness, possibility, or hypothetical results. Selecting the wrong person ending changes who performs the action.
questions.hint: Identify the subject pronoun, then apply the conditional ending for that person.
